author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
what_happened: the first Arm-A execution authorisation was refused at the pre-Isaac gates and never became an execution
THIS_IS_NOT_AN_ARM_A_FAILURE: Arm A never started. Recording this as a failed control arm would leave a reader believing the experiment was attempted and went badly

blockers.A_selector_not_wired_through_the_collect: selector injection existed in the controller layer but the collector constructed PurePursuit with no target_selector, so no production path could request an arm
blockers.B_no_manifest_driven_runner: no runner existed that could read EXECUTION_MANIFEST_V1 and produce the exact output artefacts it declared
blockers.C_stale_preflight_payload: the committed preflight recorded the pre-seam controller hash in three canonical fields, so its scientific payload described a tree that had moved

explicitly_did_not_happen: no scientific arm result was produced
methodological_correction: a valid manifest must establish declaration integrity AND execution-path existence. V1 established the first and not the second, so it was correct on paper and unrunnable at the same time
manifest_v1_status: historically frozen and NOT overwritten. Its source HEAD was correctly pinned; its executability assurance was incomplete, and that limitation is recorded here rather than repaired in place
